visualCharacteristics.purpose: fixed two-part media + copy row (1/3 media, 2/3 copy) where the media side alternates
visualCharacteristics.layout: one row, two cells side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile; media cell may be empty and render as a CSS hexagon shape
visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White background by default; one instance sits on a grass-green (#4cd300) section band with an angled photo crop; empty media cell is a navy decorative shape

contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: media cell (image, or empty for a decorative shape) and copy cell (H2, paragraphs, CTA link); cell order follows the source (image-left or image-right)
contentPattern.reason: Fixed side-by-side text + image layout from the same image-text component used across the page; never wraps into a grid
contentPattern.variantReason: Two-cell 1/3 media + 2/3 copy layout with hexagon/angled media crop; media side alternates; media may be a CSS shape only

usage: Use for a single media + copy row: put the image (or leave the cell empty for a decorative shape) in one cell and the heading, text and link in the other. Swap cell order to move the media side.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any two-cell image/text row. Use the base columns block for evenly split multi-column grids.
